values: 库露露的所有技能均会造成无视敌我的伤害。主动使用时对敌方半场进行持续的地毯式轰炸。
All of Kulu's skills deal damage to both enemies and allies. When used actively, she will relentlessly bombard the enemy side of the battlefield.

被动地，库露露的普通攻击会产生爆炸，对目标周围1格范围内的角色造成80% ATK伤害。库露露的所有技能均会造成无视敌我的伤害，但友军受到来自自身的伤害降低70%。
主动使用时，向敌方半场倾泻怒火，总共召唤14次地毯式轰炸，每次轰炸会随机选择敌方半场内的一个格子，并对半径1格范围内的所有角色造成90% + 10% ATK伤害。最后，召唤巨大化的使魔弹·阿爆，对敌方半场内的所有角色造成250% + 25% ATK伤害。该技能仅在敌方半场有敌人时可以释放，且释放期间自身获得霸体。
每次释放该技能，至少有10次轰炸会选择能够覆盖至少1名敌人的格子，且至少有6次轰炸会选择敌方最密集区域。

Passive. Kulu's normal attacks trigger an explosion that deals 80% ATK damage to the target and all adjacent units. All of Kulu's skills deal damage to both enemies and allies, but allies take 70% reduced damage.
Active. Kulu unleashes her fury, bombarding the enemy side of the battlefield 14 times. Each strike hits a random tile, dealing 90% + 10% ATK damage to all units on the target tile and its surrounding area within 1 tile. At least 10 strikes will hit areas with 1 or more enemies within, and at least 6 of those will target the area with the most enemies. After the bombardment, Kulu summons a gigantified Boomboom to deal 250% + 25% ATK damage to all units on the enemy side of the battlefield.
Kulu only casts her Ultimate if there are enemies present on their side of the battlefield. She becomes unaffected while casting her Ultimate.
每一次地毯式轰炸造成的伤害提升至100% + 10% ATK。
Each bombardment strike deals 100% + 10% ATK damage.
每一次地毯式轰炸造成的伤害提升至110% + 10% ATK。
Each bombardment strike deals 110% + 10% ATK damage.
每一次地毯式轰炸造成的伤害提升至120% + 10% ATK。
Each bombardment strike deals 120% + 10% ATK damage.
每一次地毯式轰炸造成的伤害提升至130% + 10% ATK。
Each bombardment strike deals 130% + 10% ATK damage.
战斗开始时将敌方半场边缘炸成阻碍通行的废墟。主动使用时对一名敌人造成伤害并将其击飞。
When a battle starts, Kulu bombs the enemy's border tiles closest to your side, creating debris that restricts movement. When used actively, she deals damage to an enemy and knocks them into the air.

战斗开始时，库露露将敌方半场边缘炸毁，形成阻碍通行的废墟，将位于这些格子的角色向其所在阵营方向击退。其中，正中央格子上的废墟可在受到6 + 1次攻击后被摧毁、其余格子上的废墟则永久不可破坏。
每当正中央的废墟被破坏，库露露会自动呼叫延迟爆破，在8秒后再次炸毁该格子并形成废墟。
主动使用时，库露露闪现至离自身最近的敌人面前，对其造成150% + 20% ATK伤害并将其击飞，随后返回原位。若目标位于己方半场，则改为将其向敌方半场方向击退至多3格。库露露在本技能释放期间无敌。

Passive. When a battle starts, Kulu bombs the enemy's border tiles closest to your side, creating debris that restricts movement and knocks back units on the affected tiles toward their own side of the battlefield. Debris blocking the center tile can be destroyed in 6 + 1 hits, but debris on the other tiles are indestructible.
Whenever the center debris is destroyed, Kulu marks the tile for an explosion that detonates after 8s, covering it with debris once again.
Active. Kulu teleports to the nearest enemy, dealing 150% + 20% ATK damage to that enemy and knocking them into the air. She then returns to her original tile. If the target is on the allied side of the battlefield, Kulu knocks the enemy back toward their side by up to 3 tiles instead of knocking them into the air. Kulu is invincible while casting this skill.
主动使用时造成的伤害提升至170% + 20% ATK。
Damage is increased to 170% + 20% ATK when the skill is used actively.
主动使用时造成的伤害提升至190% + 20% ATK。
Damage is increased to 190% + 20% ATK when the skill is used actively.
主动使用时造成的伤害提升至210% + 20% ATK。
Damage is increased to 210% + 20% ATK when the skill is used actively.
召唤阿爆将最靠前的两名敌人吞噬并带到敌方半场，并在过程中产生数次爆炸。
Kulu summons Boomboom to devour 2 frontmost enemies and deliver them to the enemy side of the battlefield, triggering a series of explosions as it bounces.
释放使魔弹·阿爆，阿爆会进行3次弹跳，前两跳会分别选择最靠前的2名敌人并将其吞噬、最后一跳会选择敌方半场最靠后的1名敌人并将吞噬目标吐出。阿爆每次弹跳会对落点半径1格范围内的所有角色造成110% + 10% ATK伤害，并使其移动速度降低60%，持续3秒。被吞噬的目标无法攻击和行动，且不会受到来自阿爆以外的伤害。如果最后一跳没有符合条件的目标，则改为向敌方半场方向跳至多3格。

Kulu summons Boomboom, which bounces 3 times between enemies. The first 2 bounces will target 2 frontmost enemies, devouring them. For the final bounce, Boomboom will target 1 rearmost enemy on the enemy side of the battlefield and releases all devoured enemies upon impact. Each bounce deals 110% + 10% ATK damage to its target and adjacent units, reducing their movement speed by 60% for 3s. Devoured enemies cannot act or attack and will only take damage from Boomboom. If Boomboom could not find a valid target for the final bounce, it will instead travel 3 tiles deeper into the enemy side, unless blocked by terrain or the battlefield edges.
阿爆每次弹跳造成的伤害提升至120% + 10% ATK。
阿爆每次弹跳造成的伤害提升至130% + 10% ATK。
阿爆每次弹跳造成的伤害提升至140% + 10% ATK。
提高自身攻击力，对敌人造成伤害后额外提高攻击力。
Increases ATK, with extra ATK increases when dealing damage to enemies.
战斗中提升6%攻击力。每次对敌人造成伤害，额外提高0.6%攻击力，最多叠加50层。
Increases ATK by 6% during battle. Dealing damage to enemies will increase ATK by an extra 0.6%, stacking up to 50 times.
战斗中提升8%攻击力。每次对敌人造成伤害，额外提高0.8%攻击力，最多叠加50层。
Increases ATK by 8% during battle. Dealing damage to enemies will increase ATK by an extra 0.8%, stacking up to 50 times.
战斗中提升10%攻击力。每次对敌人造成伤害，额外提高1%攻击力，最多叠加50层。
Increases ATK by 10% during battle. Dealing damage to enemies will increase ATK by an extra 1%, stacking up to 50 times.
战斗开始时为场上所有敌人施加“易爆”状态，在其被击败后将其转化为一颗会爆炸的殉爆弹。
Kulu applies an explosive debuff to all enemies, turning them into doom bombs when they're defeated.
战斗开始时，使场上所有敌人获得“易爆”状态，受到伤害提高10%，持续至战斗结束。当一名受“易爆”影响的角色被击败后，库露露会将其转化为一枚殉爆弹，并在2秒后爆炸，对半径2格内的所有单位造成210% ATK伤害，并附带殉爆弹初始生命值15%的额外伤害，最高不超过自身攻击力的300%。

When a battle starts, Kulu applies an explosive debuff to all enemies, increasing their damage taken by 10%, which lasts until the end of the battle. When an enemy with the explosive debuff is defeated, Kulu turns them into a doom bomb that detonates after 2s. The explosion deals 210% ATK damage to all units within 2 tiles, plus extra damage equal to 15% of the defeated enemy's initial HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 300% of Kulu's ATK.
殉爆弹爆炸造成的基础伤害提升至240% ATK。
The doom bomb explosion deals 240% ATK base damage.
殉爆弹爆炸造成的基础伤害提升至270% ATK。
The doom bomb explosion deals 270% ATK base damage.
每当一枚殉爆弹被引爆，库露露获得持续10秒的“爆破狂欢”状态，在此期间自身获得35点穿透，并且普通攻击、技能“狂轰滥炸”、“阿爆来袭！”的爆炸范围扩大至2格。该效果多次触发时不会叠加增益效果，但会使“爆破狂欢”状态延长对应的持续时间。

Each time a doom bomb detonates, Kulu enters Blast Mania for 10s. While in Blast Mania, she gains 35 Penetration and the explosion radius of her normal attacks, Blast Mayhem, and Boomboom Bash skills expands to 2 tiles. Subsequent detonations will extend the duration of Blast Mania, but the effects will not stack.
所在半场内没有敌人时，提升攻击速度和远程防御。
Kulu gains extra ATK SPD and Ranged DEF during battle, with the values based on the number of enemies on her half of the battlefield.
所在半场内没有敌人时，库露露获得40点攻击速度与40点远程防御；所在半场内每有一名敌人，对应的属性加成便会降低10点，最多降低至20点。同一半场内的其他友军获得该效果50%的增益。

Kulu gains extra ATK SPD and Ranged DEF during battle. If there are no enemies on Kulu's half of the battlefield, her ATK SPD increases by 40 and her Ranged DEF increases by 40. For each enemy present on Kulu's half of the battlefield, the buff values decrease by 10, down to 20. Other allies on Kulu's half of the battlefield receive a portion of these buffs, benefiting by 50% of their values.
